name: PHD finger protein 1
pathways: negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: PHF1 encodes PHD finger protein 1. Annotated molecular activities include transcription corepressor binding and histone H3K36me3 reader activity. It participates in DNA repair-dependent chromatin remodeling and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Ossifying fibromyxoid tumor, malignant. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
